title: Florida AI Laws

reading.body:
Florida has enacted exactly one AI-related law, S1816, which designates CyberBay in the Tampa Bay area as a cybersecurity and artificial intelligence innovation region.

The law is recognition and affirmation, not regulation. It imposes no requirements on developers, deployers, or users of AI, and it creates no new agency, funding stream, or compliance obligation. Its operative content is a statement of state interest in public-private collaboration for cyber readiness and economic resilience.

The text contains no provisions about compute infrastructure, data centers, or energy supply. It therefore offers no evidence about how Florida's grid or building stock constrains AI scaling, only that the legislature has chosen to name a region for AI-related economic development.

Enacted AI laws in Florida

1 law this site judged relevant to AI, newest first, each read from its enrolled text.

  • S1816: CyberBay passed 2026-03-12

    The Florida Senate recognizes CyberBay as a cybersecurity and artificial intelligence innovation region within the Tampa Bay area, acknowledges Florida's national leadership in cybersecurity preparedness and digital defense, and affirms the importance of continued public-private collaboration to strengthen cyber readiness and economic resilience.

How this page is kept

This page is generated from the enacted laws this site tracks for Florida. When the legislature passes another AI-related bill, it appears here the night the bill's text is read. The full 50-state picture is at State AI Laws.
